name: credential-guard
description: Keeps credentials out of the session transcript and keeps them usable: scans tool results, tool arguments, prompts and peer deliveries, redacts what it finds behind a placeholder, and offers the macOS login Keychain so later sessions can still use it.

promptOnly.title: Watch only what I type
promptOnly.description: One switch: judge nothing but the prompts you submit. Tool output, tool arguments and peer deliveries are not scanned at all, so no entropy finding and no warning can come from anything but your own typing. It narrows WHERE the detector looks and nothing else — it overrides onToolResult and onToolInput, while onPrompt still chooses redact or block and keychain still offers to save what it catches. Off by default: it gives up every catch in a tool's output, which is where a `cat .env` leak comes from.

shapeRules.title: Where the shape-only rules run
shapeRules.description: The entropy and hex rules judge a run by how it LOOKS, which is where the false positives are: a build id, a hash, an opaque resource name. The named provider patterns and the assignment rule read what the text calls the value, and run everywhere whatever this says. A person types a secret into a prompt, so prompts and deliveries are the default surface; "prompt+result" adds tool output, "all" adds tool arguments, "off" leaves only the rules that read the text.

minLength.description: Shortest run of secret-alphabet characters the entropy rule will consider. A floor of 20 flags 20-23 character identifiers (HTTPCode_ELB_5XX_Count, AWSLambda_FullAccess); 24 does not, and costs no recall on the labelled corpus.
minLength.title: Minimum token length

entropyRatio.description: Normalized entropy needed to flag a token: Shannon bits/char divided by log2(min(length,64)). 0.85 separates random keys from paths and prose.
entropyRatio.title: Entropy threshold

exemptRatio.title: Structure exemption threshold
exemptRatio.description: The entropy a path or identifier segment must reach before it stops counting as benign. Kept separate from entropyRatio so a nearby cue word cannot un-exempt a filesystem path.

hexMinLength.description: Shortest pure-hex run to flag. 0 disables the hex rule.
hexMinLength.title: Minimum hex length

strictHex.description: Flag 40- and 64-character lowercase hex too. Off by default because that is every git SHA and sha256 sum.
strictHex.title: Flag git SHAs and sha256 sums

flagAwsKeyIds.title: Flag a lone AWS access key ID
flagAwsKeyIds.description: An AKIA is the published half of the pair and appears in every IAM listing and audit note. Off by default: it is flagged only when a 40-character secret-shaped run sits within pairWindow characters.

pairWindow.title: Key-pair proximity window
pairWindow.description: How far from an access key ID its secret half may sit and still make the pair a finding.

onToolResult.description: What to do with findings in a tool's output.
onToolResult.title: On a tool result

onToolInput.description: What to do with findings in a tool call's own arguments. A command cannot be redacted without breaking it, so the choice is refuse or record.
onToolInput.title: On a tool call argument

onPrompt.description: What to do with findings in a submitted prompt or a peer delivery.
onPrompt.title: On a prompt or delivery

maxScanChars.description: Characters scanned per value. Past this the tail is passed through unscanned and a notice is logged.
maxScanChars.title: Maximum characters scanned

allow.title: Allowed fingerprints
allow.description: Comma-separated fingerprints (the 8 hex characters in a redaction marker) to stop flagging.

keychain.title: macOS Keychain
keychain.description: Offer to save each caught secret to the login Keychain so later sessions can use it: ask, save without asking, or never.

rehydrate.title: Substitute placeholders back
rehydrate.description: Replace a [secret:NAME] or [redacted ... #fingerprint] placeholder with the real value when a tool call runs, so a redacted secret stays usable.

rehydrateEgress.title: Substitute for tools that leave the machine
rehydrateEgress.description: Also substitute inside MCP tool calls, WebFetch and WebSearch, whose arguments are sent off this machine.

proximityWindow.title: Cue proximity window
proximityWindow.description: How many characters from a word like "api key", "token" or "password" a candidate still counts as announced. 0 disables the rule.

proximityRatio.title: Entropy threshold near a cue
proximityRatio.description: The normalized entropy a candidate needs when a cue word is nearby. Lower than the ordinary threshold because the prose already said what it is.

announcedMinLength.title: Length floor near a cue
announcedMinLength.description: The shortest candidate still considered when a cue word or an assignment announced it. Lower than minLength because a hand-chosen password is short.

ledger.title: Near-miss ledger
ledger.description: Record the shape of every candidate the detector saw and let past, so the threshold can be tuned on real traffic. Shapes only — values are never recorded.

ledgerMinRatio.title: Lowest ratio worth recording
ledgerMinRatio.description: A candidate below this normalized entropy is not worth tuning on and is not recorded.

ledgerMaxRows.title: Maximum ledger rows
ledgerMaxRows.description: Rows are pruned to this count, dropping what a threshold would learn least from. The whole plugin store is capped at 4 MiB.
